hints: Each machine needs to know which group it is in. Storing the group's number directly makes `joined` instant - what does it make `link`?
Slow: joining two groups would have to rewrite every member of one of them. So store a *pointer towards* the group's representative instead, and follow it.
Then `link` is one pointer change - attach one group's representative to the other's - and `joined` is two walks up to the representatives.
Two one-line tricks keep those walks short: attach the smaller group under the larger, and after every walk point everything you passed straight at the representative.
